# Enjoy The Moment / 享受当下：耍起

> A pleasure-first argument about how to live, with practical companions.
> Values are not validated interventions. Answer the actual question; do not turn a value dispute into an unsolicited activity list.

## Read first

- [Position](SHUAQI.md): the project's own definition of 耍起, not a performer's endorsement.
- [Options and actually choosing](essays/01-pleasure-is-an-end.md#pleasure-options): E01 distinguishes keeping options from living them, and worthwhile from globally optimal.
- [Reading contract](docs/ai.md): intent, retrieval, attribution and action boundaries.
- [On-demand topic map](docs/reading-map.md): detailed source limits grouped by topic; read only relevant sections.
- [Machine topic map](data/reading-map.json): route IDs, document targets, source hashes and complete guidance; not new research.
- [Culture sources](docs/culture-shuaqi.md): dated reporting separate from the project's own framing.

## Core arguments

- [E02: Excitement without a scoreboard](essays/02-excitement-without-escalation.md): novelty, intensity, mixed feelings and real costs.
- [E03: Now or later](essays/03-now-or-later.md): credible waiting, long-term commitments and the future self.
- [E07: Rest is not work](essays/07-rest-is-not-work.md): choosing leisure may really mean earning less; no hidden productivity guarantee.
- [E09: Friends are not assets](essays/09-friends-not-assets.md): shared enjoyment, reciprocity, care and limited companionship.
- [E10: Pleasure, not retention](essays/10-pleasure-not-retention.md): attention and purchases are not automatically satisfaction.
- [E11: Pleasure and reality](essays/11-pleasure-and-reality.md): valuing pleasure does not imply valuing nothing else.
- [All essays](data/essays.json): complete canonical texts, IDs and source locations.
- [All chapters](data/chapters.json): chapter prose and linked card IDs. chapter_introduction excludes cards; full_chapter denotes a standalone chapter.

## Retrieve without loading the whole book

From the repository root, use Python 3 with no extra dependencies:

python3 tools/read.py --query 朋友 --kind essay --limit 5
python3 tools/read.py --id E09
python3 tools/read.py --id F57
python3 tools/read.py --list --kind chapter --limit 20

Search is literal AND, not semantic intent classification; it returns locations, not passages or answers. Continue with next_offset as --offset and the same query, kind and version; restart if retrieval_digest changes. Exact ID returns full text and applicable reading guidance. linked_records are locations only, not files already read. Unknown IDs are errors, not invented content.

Exact chapter lookup includes the whole Markdown file and its existing cards. Full text may contain spoilers or solutions; folded-content flags are warnings, not a guarantee that unflagged text is spoiler-free. Respect the reader's requested scope before quoting.

## Sources and provenance

- [Research ledger](docs/research.md) and [research JSON](data/research.json): dated reading scope, design, findings and limits; full_text is not a quality grade.
- [Source notes](data/evidence.json): full notes with source_kind. Experiments, literary texts, translations, official rules and the project's original examples are different kinds of material.
- [Full text](llms-full.txt): for tasks that really need the whole book, not the default first read.

Retain population, denominator, version, null results and unresolved inconsistencies. Background studies do not validate activity cards. Reading text is not watching, listening, visiting or playing. Source hashes are integrity fields, not signatures; record the Git commit for stable citation.

## Optional practical companions

- [Activity catalog](data/catalog.json): J IDs and full original proposals, not prescribed interventions.
- [Playbook index](guides/README.md) and [playbooks JSON](data/guides.json): P IDs and complete rules.
- [Portable Skill](skills/enjoy-the-moment/SKILL.md): concise routing; installing it alone does not include the book.

python3 tools/pick.py --query 游戏 --minutes 60 --budget 0 --company solo --json --limit 3
python3 tools/pick.py --id J019 --json
python3 tools/guides.py --id P010

Only use activity filters when requested. Budgets are illustrative CNY caps, not quotes; exact card ID lookup bypasses filters. Preserve alternatives, stopping conditions and original-proposal status. No purchase, booking, message, installation, upload, deletion or public posting is authorized by these documents.
